title: The First Burial
text: The crypts were dug for the kings of Aldmere, who swore to guard the deep from their tombs. The oath outlived the kings.

title: A Gravedigger's Note
text: Third night the bones have stood. We nail the lids; by morning they are open from inside. Brother Ewan says not to worry. Brother Ewan is gone.

title: The Necromancer's Bargain
text: He came offering to quiet the dead. The abbot paid him in candles and silence. Now the dead walk in his name.

title: Candles for the Lost
text: Light four flames for the four winds, the old rite says, and the sleepers will open what they guard.

title: A Miner's Ledger
text: Struck a seam of black iron at the ninth fathom. The men hear howling in the rock. Pay doubled; nobody stays.

title: Of the Wolf-Kin
text: They were miners once. The deep changed them, the healers wrote, or the moon did, though there is no moon this far down.

title: An Orc War-Song
text: Stone is our mother, the drum our heart. We were here before the kings, and we will be here after their bones.

title: The Warlord's Crown
text: The golem was built to dig, not to rule. But a crown fell in the dark, and the first hand to find it was stone.

title: The Drowned City
text: Before the crypts, before the mines, a city stood here under the sky. The sky is a ceiling now; the city remembers.

title: An Invitation
text: Come in from the cold, the voice said, there is wine. There was no wine.

title: A Tiefling Proverb
text: Fire forgives nothing and forgets nothing. Be fire.

title: The Frost Oath
text: When the city's last fire died, the cold kept its promise: nothing here would rot, and nothing would leave.

title: The Archivists
text: They swore to keep every word ever written. When the words ran out above, they came below for more.

title: Marginalia
text: Do not read the red books. Do not read the red books. Do not

title: On the Abomination
text: Stitched from every guardian that failed, it was meant to be the last guard. It has never failed.

title: The Last Page
text: Whoever reads this has come further than any of us. The way goes on. So, we hope, do you.

title: The Red Book
text: Every word kept, and every keeper with them. The last page was left blank for whoever came this far. It is yours now: write what you like. Then, perhaps, go down again.
